app_description: Persona's own apps: whichever one you talk in, it's the same chat, and questions and approvals are answered right on their cards
feishu_description: Chat privately with your custom Lark app's bot: messages go to the main chat, and answers, progress and questions come as cards
not_paired: Not paired yet: get a pairing code in the app and send it to the bot
disconnected: Lost the connection to Lark. Reconnecting
feature_main_description: Messages go to the main chat; /new starts a new chat, /list picks a recent one, /main goes back
feature_cards_description: Sends a card when a chat Lark drives needs an answer or approval
feature_all_cards_description: Sends cards for questions and approvals from every agent on your computers
feature_pushes_description: A copy of each notification sent to your phone, plus scheduled tasks' answers
feature_sync_description: When a main chat turn not started from Lark ends, its answer goes to Lark
feature_reports_description: When tasks from the main chat finish, wait for you or get cut off, a card sums them up here
feature_board: A standing "waiting for you" card in Lark
feature_board_description: /tasks sends one card of everything waiting for you, then keeps it up to date in place instead of sending a new one
feature_workbench_description: /home brings up a pinned home card of everything going on (kept the only one and up to date), every card gets a button back to it, /today and /inbox show the day and the Inbox, and /start asks for a permission mode
feature_only_conclusions_description: Tasks from the main chat no longer send their progress (a finished turn, waiting for you, interrupted), which stays in the to-do list and the briefing; a conclusion card still comes when there is one: done, can't be done, or needs your decision
feature_report_steps_description: By default a task is pushed only when its goal changes: reached, needs your decision, or stuck. Turn this on for the old card: every agent's finished turn (with the stage bar and what the agent said), interruptions and closings too
feature_agents_description: /agents lists the agents on your computers; after you pick one, messages go to it
voice_description: Talk with Persona by voice in the app; tasks go to the main chat
no_feature: The Lark bot has no “{feature}” feature
not_running_open: {name} isn't running. Turn it on first
domain_label: Domain (feishu / lark, or a private deployment's address; feishu if left empty)
credentials_hint: In the Feishu / Lark developer console, create a custom app, turn on its bot capability, and choose to receive events over a persistent connection (docs/extensions/bots.md「在开放平台上要做的」)
console_link: Open the Feishu / Lark developer console
credentials_rejected: The App ID or App Secret was not accepted by the platform. Check them and try again.
auto_configured: The app's permissions, events and the long-connection mode were set automatically, and its publish was submitted.
auto_config_manual: The app could not be configured automatically ({what}).
auto_config_bot_capability: its bot capability is not on yet
auto_config_patch_scope: the "Modify app info" permission (application:application:patch) is not open on it
auto_config_not_self_built: it was not created in the developer console, so it cannot be configured or published this way
auto_config_unreachable: the open platform could not be reached; it will be tried again next time
pair_hint: Send these 6 digits to the bot in a private chat in Lark (valid for 10 minutes)
